question: Will Harry Kane score the most goals in the 2026-27 UEFA Champions League?
requirements: If the 2026-27 Champions League competition is cancelled, postponed after June 19, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or there is otherwise no official leader declared within that timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".
context: This market will resolve to the player who scores the most goals through all main tournament rounds of the 2026-27 UEFA Champions League competition.
In the event of a tie, this market will resolve according to the official leader as determined by UEFA.
If multiple leaders are announced, this market will resolve to the player whose listed last name comes first alphabetically.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from UEFA (https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/statistics/players/goals/); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
